name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.230: Timestamps show local time again on a server that does not run on UTC.
    Run times, the statistics period and diagnostics came from the database without a
    timezone designator, and browsers read such a value as LOCAL time — on a Berlin
    server a run stored as 07:36 UTC read 7:36 AM although it happened at 9:36 AM. The
    stamps are now marked as UTC before formatting. Also: the refetch description names
    its two directions outright, "both download and upload".
